executed.title: Explicit sample-index-to-world affine and inverse
executed.rationale: A discriminating arithmetic check for the proposed column-vector matrix convention, nonzero origin, anisotropic scales, and axis rotation/permutation. Expected for index [4,3,2] under the supplied matrix is world [99.25,202,304] micrometers; applying the supplied inverse returns [4,3,2].
executed.code:
m = data["index_to_world"]
p = data["point_index"]
world = [sum(m[r][c] * (p + [1])[c] for c in range(4)) for r in range(3)]
inv = data["world_to_index"]
q0 = [world[i] - m[i][3] for i in range(3)]
back = [sum(inv[r][c] * q0[c] for c in range(3)) for r in range(3)]
print("input sample-center index xyz:", p)
print("world xyz um:", world)
print("inverse sample-center index xyz:", back)
print("roundtrip exact:", back == p)
assert world == [99.25, 202.0, 304.0]
assert back == p

proposed_unexecuted.title: Calibrated annotation/export round trip
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Use 2D and 3D fixtures with nonzero origins, anisotropic spacing, axis flips/permutations, and a rotated affine. Export/reimport vector coordinates, physical coordinates, scope, frame and source IDs. Test a known pixel marker for every external tool adapter to establish center/edge offset.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Frame/source identity and coordinates round-trip within a declared serialization tolerance; adapter offset matches the pinned convention. W4 is not a substitute.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Instrument metadata and calibration fixtures
proposed_unexecuted.plan: For every supported instrument/layout, assert axes, shape, original metadata retention, accepted value/unit/frame, and reader version; include TVIPS fixture if distribution permits.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: A reader update that changes calibration semantics fails a fixture before annotations are made.

proposed_unexecuted.title: 3 GB bounded-read and cancellation benchmark
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Benchmark representative tiled and multi-page 3 GB inputs on the 8-core/16 GB target; measure p95 viewport latency, peak RSS, hash time, cache behavior, progress and cancellation.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Agree practical thresholds with users first; report results per file layout and hardware. No numeric performance claim is made from docs.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Interrupted import/save/export and shared-storage recovery
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Interrupt each staged-generation/commit-marker and export publication step on local and actual shared storage; reopen, relocate paths, and compare source hashes.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Only a complete committed snapshot/export is accepted, last good state can be recovered, and source bytes remain unchanged.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Display, editing, and accessibility workflow
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Test view changes against source identity and samples; test a recorded resample; exercise keyboard-only navigation, scoped annotations, undo/redo through reopen, progress/cancel, and readable metadata/error feedback.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Display actions leave source samples/identity unchanged; geometric ops create derived provenance; required workflows are operable without a mouse.
